findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics 11 chapter practice (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 19.1 6, 19.2 4, 19.3 2, 19.4 2, 19.5 6, 19.6 2, 19.7A 2.

12 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering the nucleus and nuclide notation, mass defect and binding energy, the binding energy curve, fission, chain reaction and critical mass, the nuclear reactor, fusion, activity and decay constant, half-life, exponential decay and T½ = 0.693/λ, radioactive tracers and annihilation. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: 1 u = 1/12 of carbon-12, iron-56, A = λN, (1/2)³N₀, deuterium-tritium fuels, slow-neutron absorption by control rods, number of nuclei (not nucleons) from molar mass.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
